title: CvSU Faculty Connect: An Information Management System for CvSU Faculty
subtitle: A centralized faculty operations and communication platform
description: CvSU Faculty Connect is a commissioned capstone project that brings faculty administration, announcements, events, accomplishment reports, financial records, analytics, and real-time messaging into one role-aware platform.

overview.challenge: CvSU faculty operations span multiple campuses, colleges, personnel roles, events, reports, financial records, and communication workflows. The platform needed to make these connected responsibilities manageable while presenting each user with the tools and information appropriate to their role.
overview.solution: We developed a responsive information management system with a Next.js and TypeScript frontend and a Laravel backend. I led the frontend implementation, building the reusable interface architecture and the role-specific experiences for administration, analytics, events, accomplishments, finances, and real-time messaging.

contributors.name: Joseph Bataller
contributors.imageAlt: Joseph Bataller wearing a black graduation robe
contributions: Built the responsive Next.js and TypeScript frontend architecture, including the application shell, mobile and desktop navigation, shared form controls, dialogs, tables, pagination, loading states, and reusable data hooks.

Implemented claim-based authentication and role-based interfaces for administrators, coordinators, members, and job-order personnel, together with user, faculty, campus, officer, and organizational-position management.

Developed the analytics and announcements dashboard with announcement CRUD, attachments, visibility controls, likes, and filterable campus allocation, college allocation, and gender-distribution visualizations.
Delivered calendar-based event discovery, event management, visibility controls, document and image uploads, and complete accomplishment-report creation, editing, viewing, and export workflows.
Built financial allocation and contribution interfaces for recording allocations, tracking member payments, presenting budget summaries, filtering records, paginating results, and exporting reports.

Implemented the real-time messaging experience with conversation creation and search, responsive navigation, optimistic delivery, attachments, message normalization, and Laravel Echo and Pusher updates.
